description: This file contains styling rules specifically for form controls such as inputs, labels, checkboxes, and radio buttons within a Bootstrap-based project. It defines appearance, sizing, focus states, and layout for various form elements, including customizations for disabled, read-only, and inline forms.
external_files: variables for SCSS variables like $input-height, $input-padding-y, etc.
Bootstrap mixins like @include font-size(), @include border-radius(), @include box-shadow(), @include transition(), @include form-control-focus(), and @include form-validation-state()

classes.name: form-control
classes.description: Base class for styling text-based form controls such as input, select, and textarea.

classes.name: form-control-file
classes.description: Styles file input controls, ensuring they display as block elements topping full width.

classes.name: form-control-range
classes.description: Styles range input controls, similar to text inputs.

classes.name: col-form-label
classes.description: Used for labels in horizontal and inline forms, aligning label text with controls.

classes.name: form-control-plaintext
classes.description: Displays readonly controls as plain text without border or background.

classes.name: form-group
classes.description: Provides vertical margin and spacing for grouping form elements.

classes.name: form-text
classes.description: Provides block-level help text below form controls.

classes.name: form-row
classes.description: A flex container for tight form layouts with nested columns.

classes.name: form-check
classes.description: Container for checkbox and radio button controls.

classes.name: form-check-input
classes.description: Styles checkbox or radio input elements within a form-check container.

classes.name: form-check-label
classes.description: Label associated with checkbox or radio inputs, with margin reset.

classes.name: form-inline
classes.description: Styles to make entire forms display inline and adapt to small screens.

methods.name: font-size
methods.description: Mixin applying font size styles to input controls.

methods.name: border-radius
methods.description: Mixin applying border-radius styles for rounded corners.

methods.name: form-control-focus
methods.description: Mixin for styling focus states of form controls.

methods.name: form-validation-state
methods.description: Mixin for showing validation styling for form controls based on validation state.
